# Waveswell Retreats

> Waveswell Retreats runs seven day stand up paddle surf retreats in El Salvador, coached by Josselyn "Joss" Alabi, a professional paddle surfer with more than fifteen years across many water sports who has represented El Salvador across nearly three Olympic cycles. Seven days, six nights, limited spots.

## What we do
Waveswell Retreats is a stand up paddle (SUP) surf retreat and coaching business based in El Salvador, Central America, operating out of La Union and La Libertad. The core product is a seven day, six night retreat for SUP surfers and SUP paddlers who can already stand on a paddle board and want to genuinely ride great waves rather than simply catch them. Spots are limited, with a maximum of six people and occasionally one more. Every session is filmed, the footage is reviewed with the group, and the week adds hours of one to one high performance coaching drawn from elite sport. Retreats run November to March. From April to October the business runs one to one coaching on the client's own dates. Board and paddle rentals are available year round. Part of every retreat funds Mar de Suenos, a Salvadoran social project that puts coastal children through school using sport as the entry point.

## Services
- The Waveswell Retreat (7 days): six nights, all meals, accommodation, airport transfers, daily SUP surf sessions, daily group video analysis, one to one high performance coaching, tours around El Salvador, all photos and video. Limited spots. 2026 rates are being confirmed, so contact Joss for a quote. November to March.
- One to one SUP surf coaching: two hour private sessions, no minimum number of days, on the client's own dates. Mainly April to October.
- Board and paddle rental: $455 for a full seven day retreat, so guests do not have to fly with their own board. Daily rental also available.

## Problems we solve
- "I can stand on the board but I never really ride the wave." Most guests drop in, go straight down the line and get off. Waveswell teaches reading the ocean, technique and wave selection so the ride actually becomes a ride.
- "I am 60 and I think I have hit my ceiling." The retreat treats limiting beliefs about the body as the actual obstacle, using high performance tools from Olympic cycle training, applied one to one.
- "I do not want to fly with a paddle board." US airlines stopped accepting boards over seven feet. Renting a board and paddle for the whole retreat costs $455.
- "I am not sure a surf trip is safe at my age." El Salvador has warm water and waves all year, spots on every retreat are limited, and every session is coached by a competing professional.
- "I want a trip that means something." Part of every retreat funds Mar de Suenos.

## Who it is for
SUP surfers and SUP paddlers who have been practising stand up paddle for a while, can stand up unaided on the board, and can swim on their own. There is no age limit in either direction. Most guests travel from the United States and Canada. It is NOT for absolute beginners (they should book one to one coaching first), and it is NOT for shortboard or longboard surfers: Waveswell specialises in stand up paddle surf only.

## Proof
- Josselyn Alabi has more than fifteen years across many water sports and has represented El Salvador as a professional SUP surfer across nearly three Olympic cycles.
- World Championship appearances in Nicaragua (2014, top 10 globally), Mexico (2015), Denmark (2017), El Salvador (2019), Puerto Rico (2020), Mexico (2022, winner of the Sayulita Open) and France (2023).
- Pan American Games: top 7 in Lima 2019, top 9 in Santiago 2023. Pan American Surfing Games: top 6 in 2018.
- Bolivarian Games: bronze 2013, silver 2014, first place 2016.
- El Salvador Rowing Single Skull national champion, 2012.
- Named Country Brand Ambassador for El Salvador in 2017.
- Founder of Mar de Suenos, a social enterprise supporting 15 to 20 coastal children per year with scholarships.
- Returning guests include Sherry Correl, aged 72, from the United States.

## Practical facts
- Location: La Union and La Libertad, El Salvador. Fly into El Salvador International Airport.
- Group size: minimum 3, maximum 7. Below 3 the retreat is cancelled and refunded, or converted into one to one coaching.
- Not included: flights, travel and medical insurance, alcoholic drinks, board rental.
- Payment: a deposit reserves the spot, with the balance due before travel.
- Languages: English and Spanish.

# Full content

## About Josselyn "Joss" Alabi

Josselyn Alabi is a professional stand up paddle surfer from El Salvador. She was raised in a family of athletes. In 2011 she decided to chase surfing, and began an intensive athletic training programme to reach the fitness level it required. In 2012 she was invited onto the national rowing team and, in the same year, became the top ranked rower in El Salvador, taking national titles and international medals. In 2013 she was called into the national surf team and became the first ever female representative for El Salvador in Stand Up Paddle.

She holds a Bachelor's degree in Business Economics and is completing an MBA specialising in the sports industry. Since 2017 she has been a Country Brand Ambassador for El Salvador, and for the first two years she was the sole representative in the sports field. In 2018 she joined the Global Shapers Community, a World Economic Forum initiative, as a member of the San Salvador hub. Alongside competing, she works in public relations through television, radio, magazines and motivational talks for schools, NGOs and companies.

Her stated mission is to inspire Salvadoran youth, and eventually the world, to become better versions of themselves and pursue their dreams by breaking boundaries through education, happiness, peace and integrity.

## Competitive record

- 2012: El Salvador Rowing Single Skull champion
- 2013: Bronze, Bolivarian Games, SUP Surf
- 2014: Silver, Bolivarian Games, SUP Surf. World Championship in Nicaragua, top 10 globally
- 2015: World Championship in Mexico
- 2016: National Recognition for Sporting Success from the President of El Salvador. First place, Bolivarian Games
- 2017: Named Brand Ambassador for the country. World Championship hosted by Denmark
- 2018: Top 6, Pan American Surfing Games
- 2019: Top 7, Pan American Games, Lima, Peru. World Championship hosted by El Salvador. Second worldwide in a digital app competition of SUP surfing
- 2020: World Championship in Puerto Rico
- 2022: World Championship, and winner of the Sayulita Open, Mexico. Qualified for the Pan American Games
- 2023: World Championship athlete, France. Top 9, Pan American Games, Santiago, Chile

## The retreat, in detail

The Waveswell Retreat is six nights and seven days. A ten day format has been run once on request and can be arranged again.

A typical week: guests are collected at El Salvador International Airport and driven to the house. Surf sessions run daily, matched to conditions and to each person's level. Someone films from the shore throughout, without the guests being conscious of it. The group sits down together to review that footage, and each person leaves the session with three specific objectives, deliberately no more, because a week spread across many objectives achieves none of them.

Separately, each guest has a one to one conversation with Joss. This is the part guests describe as the surprise. It reads the person's approach and personality, and connects it to what is visibly happening in their surfing: rigidity, self demand, insistence on doing it one way when the ocean is offering another. Guests have described being left with "existential doubts" after those conversations. The tools used come from high performance sport, learned across nearly three Olympic cycles and from an international career development coach, Driss (thebodyandmindcoach.com), and they transfer directly back into professional and everyday life.

Before arrival, guests who have paid receive a form covering their objectives, their experience, and any dietary requirements, including vegan, vegetarian and allergies, so meals are prepared accordingly.

### Included
- 6 nights in a private or shared room in the house in La Union
- Airport pick up and drop off
- Technical stand up paddle surf lessons and sessions
- Personalised surf coaching and guidance
- Daily post session video coaching and group video analysis
- One to one high performance coaching
- All meals, snacks and beverages, freshly prepared
- Tours: the islands of La Union by boat, a coffee farm on a volcano, waterfalls
- All video footage and photographs from the surf sessions
- A goodie bag

### Not included
- Flights
- Travel insurance and medical insurance
- Alcoholic drinks
- Board and paddle rental. $455 for the whole retreat if the guest does not bring their own board. This is well below the regular daily rate, and most guests take it, because US airlines stopped accepting boards over seven feet and paddle boards are larger and heavier than that.

Assistance with booking flights and insurance can be arranged through a travel contact the business works with.

### Group size and cancellation
Minimum three people, maximum seven. If a retreat does not reach three people it is suspended and guests are refunded. Where guests have already bought flights, the booking can be converted into one to one coaching instead.

### Partners who do not surf
Partners who do not paddle surf are welcome at an adjusted rate that keeps the room, the meals and the tours and removes the surf sessions, the equipment and the surf transport. Separate tours or private coaching can also be arranged for them while the group is in the water.

## One to one coaching

Available mainly April to October, when the retreat season is over and the Atlantic side of the region goes flat. Sessions are two hours a day, with no minimum number of days. Equipment is charged separately. One to one coaching is also the recommended starting point for anyone who cannot yet stand on a paddle board, before joining a group retreat.

Joss is explicit that one to one coaching is effective but is not a substitute for the retreat: two hours a day for seven days is not the same as being immersed for seven days.

## The four breaks

- Playa Blanca: where the group stays and where they surf the most. You wake up watching this beautiful beach.
- Maculis: gentle waves, and secret spots you need to see with your own eyes.
- Las Flores: one of the most beautiful waves in the country with swell. During retreat season it is a very fun wave with kind sets.
- Punta Mango: like Punta Roca, but on the other side of the country. With a perfect swell, get ready for action.

Boat trips also run out to the islands of the Gulf of Fonseca, past reefs, with volcanoes on three sides. Whales pass through occasionally.

## Why El Salvador

El Salvador is consistently ranked among the ten best surf destinations in the world and is known as a safe country. There are waves all year, so there is no "wave season" to wait for, and the water is warm enough that no one uses a wetsuit. Rain on the coast falls mostly at night, and the heaviest storm period is September. Retreats concentrate on November through March, which is winter in North America, and run up to Easter week.

## Brands and institutions Josselyn Alabi has worked with

Powerade, Bayer, UNICEF, Disney, Kotex, Marca Pais El Salvador, the El Salvador Olympic Committee, FESASURF, Hurley, Vijosa and Arteria Estudio.

## Mar de Suenos

Mar de Suenos is a social start up founded by Josselyn Alabi that uses sport to transmit values, virtues and high goals to children on the Salvadoran coastline, supporting their personal and professional development. It works on three pillars: academic education, delivered through school and university scholarships; values education, delivered through coaching sessions and guided films and books; and sports education, delivered through interactive activities.

It commits to a child from the age of about 10 through to graduation, with the aim of placing them in good jobs afterwards, and selects a maximum of 15 to 20 beneficiaries per year. It works with volunteers from ESEN, the School of Economics and Business in El Salvador, and is expanding to more Salvadoran universities.

Waveswell exists to make Mar de Suenos financially self sustaining. The long term vision is a chain of hotel schools, where guests stay in the hotel and young people from the programme study next door and do their practical training inside the hotel.

Mar de Suenos can be reached at mardesuenos.info@gmail.com and on Instagram at @mardesuenos.sv.

## Frequently asked questions

Do I need to know how to surf already?
You need to already be able to stand up on a paddle board on your own. The retreat is not for absolute beginners, because the group moves together and a first timer would be learning while everyone else is riding. If you have never been on a board, start with one to one coaching sessions first and join a retreat once you can stand reliably.

How much does the Waveswell retreat cost?
The 2026 rates are being confirmed, so contact Joss for a quote. The price covers accommodation, all meals, airport transfers, every surf session, daily video analysis, the one to one coaching work, tours around El Salvador and your photos and video. The final price depends on whether you take a single, double or triple room.

What is not included in the price?
Flights, travel and medical insurance, alcoholic drinks, and board rental are not included. If you do not want to fly with your own board, a board and paddle for the whole retreat is $455.

How big are the groups?
Three people minimum and seven maximum. If a retreat does not reach three people it is cancelled and everyone is refunded, and if you have already bought your flights the booking can be converted into one to one coaching instead.

Which airport do I fly into?
El Salvador International Airport, in El Salvador, Central America. Check this carefully when booking, because there are airports with similar names in other countries. The transfer from and to the airport is included.

When is the best time to come?
Retreats run November to March, which is the high season. From April to October the focus shifts to one to one coaching on your own dates. There are waves all year and the water is warm enough that you never need a wetsuit.

Can my partner come if they do not paddle surf?
Yes. Partners who do not surf are welcome at an adjusted rate that keeps the room, the meals and the tours but takes out the surf sessions, the equipment and the surf transport.

Is this stand up paddle only, or regular surfing too?
Stand up paddle surfing only. Waveswell specialises in SUP surf, not shortboard or longboard surfing.

Are there discounts?
No standing discounts are offered.
